title: Questions, information and answers required before any decision
policy: Answers not established from evidence are left BLANK. Nothing is inferred.

rows.question: Where will official market open/close prices come from?
rows.known: The NFL publishes no betting lines of any kind (re-confirmed live 2026-11-15: the Wk-11 schedule page carries kickoff time and network only). Every market cell is blank (FB-01).
rows.unknown: Whether any authorized source's terms permit redistribution of prices on a public site, and whether the owner accepts a third-party single-book price as the basis of any claim.
rows.settle: A written owner verdict on acceptable price sources (SG-01) plus the provider's terms of use.
rows.blocks: Every market column, G7, real staking ROI, reward payments, the residual-vs-market view.

rows.question: What price is actually obtainable for a straight-up side pick?
rows.known: Staking assumes a flat −110 on any pick (declared in strategies.json). Real favorite prices carry much heavier juice.
rows.unknown: The observable price for each pick, which depends on Q01.
rows.settle: Q01 resolved; then recompute staking at observed prices.

rows.question: Are the 105 aggregate-verified games (weeks 2–8) correct?
rows.known: All 32 teams' aggregates match the official standings (160/160 cells); 32 games re-read line-by-line match; 105 rows are aggregate-verified only.
rows.unknown: Whether every individual row in weeks 2–8 matches its official game page.
rows.settle: Re-read the 105 remaining official game pages one by one (SG-02).
rows.blocks: Trust in the full backtest and correlation sample.

rows.question: What depth (2nd/3rd/4th string) do replacements actually sit at?
rows.known: Depth is published only where official prose states the string (SEA QB proven 1st/2nd backup). nfl.com team depth-chart pages return 404.
rows.unknown: A verified depth-order for all 32 clubs.
rows.settle: Resolve the depth-order source (route a: per-club pages — 404; route b: snap counts — no official source) for all 32 clubs (SG-04).
rows.blocks: Replacement-depth completeness, the deficiency matrix, the backup-deficiency feature.

rows.question: Which strategies are genuinely skill-based rather than lucky?
rows.known: S1 beats a coin-flip baseline (0.673, CI 0.578–0.756, placebo p<0.002) and edges a contemporaneous better-record baseline (0.635), but the record comparison was post-hoc. S2/S3 fail their gates; S4 n=7.
rows.unknown: Whether S1's edge survives a pre-registered prospective test and multiplicity control.
rows.settle: Pre-registered prospective Week 11+ evaluation (G8) + a pre-registered paired test vs the record baseline (SG-03/SG-05).
rows.blocks: Leaderboard points, promotion of any strategy to LIVE.

rows.question: Is there an official snap-count source to use as a starter proxy?
rows.known: nfl.com publishes no per-game snap-count feed. Snap counts would give a measurable starter/backup split.
rows.unknown: Whether any authorized official source provides snap counts.
rows.settle: Identify an official snap-count source, or accept that the starter proxy stays unavailable.

rows.question: Which single dashboard should be canonical among the 17+ NFL namespaces?
rows.known: The repository holds 17+ overlapping NFL namespaces, each a partial slice of the same brief.
rows.settle: An owner decision to adopt one namespace as canonical and archive the rest (SG-08).
rows.blocks: None technically, but it multiplies maintenance and confuses review.

rows.question: Can player-prop combinations be priced at all under the official-source rule?
rows.known: Official season averages exist; official per-game player logs do not. Prop variance and prop-pair correlation are therefore unavailable.
rows.unknown: Whether an authorized per-game player log exists.
rows.settle: An official per-game player log source, or accept prop combos remain blocked (FB-05).
